title: Cyclotomic roots over a field of admissible characteristic
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $N\geq1$ an integer whose image in $K$ is nonzero, and $z\in K$. Let $\Phi_{N,K}\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be the coefficientwise image of the integer cyclotomic polynomial, the monic family characterized by $T^n-1=\prod_{d\mid n}\Phi_d(T)$ for $n\geq1$. Then $\Phi_{N,K}(z)=0$ if and only if $z$ is a primitive $N$th root of unity: $z^N=1$ and, for every natural number $b$, $z^b=1$ implies $N\mid b$.
